title: From protest laws to deaths in custody, Minns’ rush to claim the conservative high ground is clumsy and costly
summary: At almost every opportunity, the NSW premier chooses a conservative path: get the cops on side and let nobody fault Labor’s toughness on crime. It’s not working Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast There is a lesson for Chris Minns in the NSW supreme court’s declaration that police powers to deal with protesters near places of worship are invalid: laws curtailing civil liberties should never be rushed. They should certainly not be pushed through in an atmosphere of panic and incomplete facts such as existed in the fevered days after the now notorious Dural caravan incident . summary: Release notes Important This release is mandatory for all node operators. If you have encountered the code missing issue, operators will need to update and resync their nodes. This fix should prevent it from happening in the future.
